results.title: Swiss President Parmelin to Visit India from October 5-7
results.description: Swiss President Guy Parmelin will pay a state visit to India from October 5 to 7 at the invitation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, with trade, investment, technology and mobility expected to feature prominently in discussions between the two countries. According to the Ministry of External Affairs, the visit will be Parmelin’s first state visit [...] The post Swiss President Parmelin to Visit India from October 5-7 first appeared on Global Indian News Network .

results.title: India vs Pakistan Asian Games 2026 Gold Medal Match: Check Date, Time, Venue, Live Streaming and More
results.description: Team India and Pakistan are set to clash in a historic Gold Medal match at the Asian Games 2026 in Nisshin. This highly anticipated T20I encounter marks their first-ever meeting at the continental games. Fans can watch the fierce rivalry unfold live on the Sony Sports Network and SonyLIV.
